response.text: I'll look at each anomaly more closely, along with the journal/AP linkage, the signs, and the memo and reference fields.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'unbal' k, h."JRNL_NO"::text a, h."PRD_ID"::text b, h."POST_DT"::text c, h."SRC_CD" d, coalesce(h."SRC_REF",'') e, coalesce(h."MEMO",'') f, (SELECT sum("DR_AMT")::text||' / '||sum("CR_AMT")::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") g FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT"))
UNION ALL SELECT 'outside_prd', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."SRC_CD", coalesce(h."SRC_REF",''), coalesce(h."MEMO",''), '' FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'reflink', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."SRC_CD", coalesce(h."SRC_REF",''), coalesce(h."MEMO",''), h."REF_JRNL_NO"::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'badacct', l."JRNL_NO"::text, l."LN_SEQ"::text, l."ACCT_CD", '', '', '', l."DR_AMT"::text||'/'||l."CR_AMT"::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'neginv', i."INV_ID"::text, i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO"::text, i."INV_DT"::text, i."INV_AMT"::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT"<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'paymismatch', i."INV_ID"::text, i."STAT_CD", i."INV_AMT"::text, p.s::text, p.n::text, '', '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN (SELECT "INV_ID", sum("PAY_AMT") s, count(*) n FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1) p USING("INV_ID") WHERE p.s<>i."INV_AMT"

SELECT h."SRC_CD", l."ACCT_CD", c."ACCT_TYP", count(*) n, sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr, sum(CASE WHEN l."DR_AMT"=0 AND l."CR_AMT"=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_lines FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT h."SRC_CD", count(*) n, count(DISTINCT "SRC_REF") users, min("MEMO") minmemo, max("MEMO") maxmemo, count("MEMO") memos, count("SRC_REF") refs, min("SRC_REF") minref, max("SRC_REF") maxref, min("JRNL_NO") minj, max("JRNL_NO") maxj FROM "GLJRNH" h GROUP BY 1
